$description: What is known about each filament in palette.filament, for matching screen colors to real spools. The hex values in brand-inputs.json were sampled from photos, so they are approximate: lighting, white balance and the camera all move them. Decided 2026-10-15: the spools are identified by maker, product and color name only. Jeremiah cannot see color codes on the Amazon listings and will not add them, so this is final: treat each swatch as a reminder of the color, not a specification, and settle a color with a printed proof under daylight.

printer.model: Bambu Lab A1 mini (180 × 180 × 180 mm bed), confirmed by Jeremiah 2026-10-14
printer.nozzle: 0.4mm (assumed; brand/tokens/core/size.json → physical.* is sized for it)

light-gray.notes: The body of most parts (65 % in mix a, 60 % in mix b). Rock White is flecked, so a printed swatch will read slightly darker and busier than the flat sample.
